## Change

Explain the user-visible change and link the issue, if any.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests, full suite, lint, types, and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Payload, plug-in, API, and report compatibility are preserved or explained.
- [ ] Untrusted inputs and optional-tool failures stay bounded and explicit.
- [ ] No credentials, private evidence, restricted datasets, or unsupported accuracy claims.
